# korean-word-of-the-day — static word bank and deterministic date rotation

## Triggers & guarantees

- **deterministic rotation** — the word index is derived from the local calendar date with no API, tokens, or network involved, so the same date always renders the same word (words.js:16).
- **day-one match** — index 0 is 설레다, so day one matches the approved mockup exactly (words.js:17).
- **data-only word addition** — the word bank shape mirrors exactly what the Resting Screen design renders, so adding a word is data-only (words.js:3).

## Decision semantics

### Word rotation

Input: local calendar date. Output: a word index into `window.KOREAN_WORDS`. Rotation is deterministic by date, with no API, tokens, or network involved (words.js:16).

### Pronunciation canonicalisation

Input: a word's `roman` field. Output: the `sound` field. The `sound` field is deliberately NOT the same string as `roman`, because Revised Romanization is a transliteration, not a pronunciation guide (words.js:7).

### Syllable shaping

Entries should be 1–4 syllables where possible, with the hero line auto-shrinking past 4 (words.js:19). The design breathes best at 2–3 syllables (words.js:20).

## Constants that matter

| name | value | consequence |
|---|---|---|
| `window.KOREAN_WORDS` | global array | the word bank is stored here (words.js:22) |
| index 0 | 설레다 | day one matches the approved mockup exactly (words.js:17) |
| syllable minimum | 1 | entries should be 1–4 syllables where possible (words.js:19) |
| syllable maximum | 4 | hero line auto-shrinks past 4 syllables (words.js:19) |
| design sweet spot | 2–3 syllables | the design breathes best at this range (words.js:20) |
